A number of critics have described the piece as existentialist, though Camus always denied belonging to this philosophy. The seven OPEC+ nations, namely Saudi Arabia, Russia, Iraq, Kuwait, Kazakhstan, Algeria, and Oman, have agreed keep oil production quotas in December at the previous month’s level, OPEC said. "The seven participating countries decided to maintain September 2026 required production for December 2026." As follows from the OPEC table, Russia’s quota in December 2026 will stand at 9.949 mln barrels a day, Saudi Arabia’s at 10.478 mln barrels a day, Iraq’s - at 4.431 mln barrels a day, Kuwait’s - at 2.676 mln barrels a day, Kazakhstan’s - at 1.628 mln barrels a day, Algeria’s - at 1.007 mln barrels a day, and Oman’s - at 841,000 barrels a day. "The seven countries reiterated their collective commitment to achieve full conformity with the Declaration of Cooperation," OPEC said. "The seven OPEC+ countries will continue to hold monthly meetings to review market conditions. The next meeting will be held on 29 November 2026.".
